action.description: One of: search, info, stats, browse, channels, flake-inputs, cache, store. Use browse for an option prefix or Noogle hierarchy. Legacy alias: options.

query.description: Search term for 'search', exact name for 'info', prefix path for 'browse'. For flake-inputs: input_name or input:path. For store: absolute /nix/store/ path. Leave empty for 'stats'/'channels'.

source.description: Source: nixos, home-manager, darwin, flakes, flakehub, nixvim, nvf, wiki, nix-dev, noogle, nixhub, microvm, flake-parts, nur, nix-locate or pinned. For flake-inputs, legacy directory paths are also accepted.

type.description: NixOS search: packages, options, programs, flakes. NixOS info: package, option. Flake-inputs: list, ls, read, lock. Store: ls, read.

channel.description: NixOS index for package and option queries, e.g. unstable (default) or stable. Omit for cache and pinned lookups.

version.description: Only used by action=cache. Package version (default: latest).

system.description: System such as x86_64-linux. Required for source=pinned, optional filter for cache.

flake_dir.description: Local project directory for source=pinned and action=flake-inputs.

input.description: Locked nixpkgs-compatible input name or input path for source=pinned.
